<details>
This is a standard uninstall script for the inara AUR package. It performs routine file removal operations:

1. Removes the main executables (`inara`, `inara_gui`) from `/usr/bin`
2. Removes the desktop entry file (`inara.desktop`) from `/usr/share/applications`

There are no network requests, no code downloads, no obfuscation, and no operations on unrelated system files.

The unquoted variables are hardcoded to absolute paths with no user input, so word splitting/globbing risk is negligible in practice.
